text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Huh, isn't Yukino Bijin supposed to be
running in the Osaka Hai after this?”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho was at Hanshin too, right? I feel like there were way more people back then, though...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It just means the "Yukino boom" has settled down.
Last year was abnormal, after all~
Well, fads always fade without reason.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So Yukino Bijin is finally getting properly evaluated, huh?
She must be relieved too, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Alright!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —I'm baaack~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As soon as Yukino Bijin arrived at the venue,
she dashed off, wanting to check out the vibe of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ well, as expected,
things are a bit different from last year.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Getting cheered on like that...
it really was an amazin' thing, wasn't it."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...I failed to seize
such a golden opportunity."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So just like that, like melting snow,
everyone's hearts simply drifted away.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, I knew it would happen. That's just how fads go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—That's precisely why this time, with my running,
I'm gonna start a whole new boom!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "If I can do it with my own strength, it definitely won't just melt away."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"At the Oaks, I swore I wouldn't lose.
I don't wanna prove my desperate running was a mistake!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I can't let myself falter here!
The 'city girl' I'm aiming to be wouldn't just stop in her tracks!"
choice_data_list: If you keep running, you'll reach it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I believe so too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
That girl...

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
It's okay, I'll be fine today..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Her complexion looks awful.
She doesn't seem to have any confidence either.
choice_data_list: Maybe the loss in her last race is still affecting her.
Maybe the loss in her last race is still affecting her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In her previous race, Harp Alpha ran under heavy expectations as a favorite.
Yet, she couldn't even manage to place on the board."
choice_data_list: She was carrying such huge expectations...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And so she had... that look of sheer anguish on her face...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Back then, you looked like such an amazin' big-city Umamusume... but turns out, nobody's completely perfect.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, less worried and more like...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it...
...Frustrating, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"She was super sparkly,
and the way she ran was crazy cool."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I got so much of that 'I don't wanna lose' drive from ya too.
Though I guess we never really talked about it before.
choice_data_list: It's not too late even now.
It's not too late even now, you know.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Isn't that unnecessary?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I-I'm off...!

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text:
...!
What?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, this is the first time
we've had a proper talk, isn't it... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
'Cause I've only ever watched
from far away, see.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...It was all thanks to you
that I was able to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I thought she was so cool, and it gave me the courage to want to be like that.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I messed up, though.
Even so, I'm plannin' to give it my all from here on!

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: ...Why bring that up now?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um... Knowing that someone's watching you
gives you courage, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We're rivals... but still,
I'm rooting for you too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Please show us that sparkly, star-like running of yours again!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A'ight then...
Let's run today too!
